descriptor.name: ANDF e-Foncier cadastral parcels — Cotonou
descriptor.scope: Verified bounded Cotonou cadastral parcel samples from the ANDF e-Foncier service. Only the configured Cotonou entry is enabled; coverage beyond the tested cells and national completeness are unverified.
descriptor.licenceNote: ANDF describes public consultation and duplication except personal or confidential information, with online/private access subject to conditions and fees. GeoServer Fees NONE / AccessConstraints NONE are service defaults, not a reuse licence. Publisher conditions remain informational.
descriptor.attribution: ANDF (Agence Nationale du Domaine et du Foncier), e-Foncier cadastral parcels; adapted to WGS84. Verified Cotonou samples only.

evidence: ANDF e-Foncier GeoServer WFS parcel layer.
